item.title: Drain blocked and overflowing, 15th November
item.description:
The drain located between "Top Of The Hill" and "Inglecroft" a short way down Post Office Lane is blocked and overflowing. The kerbing is insufficiently high to channel the water further down the hill (reported many times). Water is now flowing over the pavement into "The Manse", and down the Inglecroft driveway and thence into The Manse at another point. Sandbags have had to be deployed to prevent water ingress via air bricks.

item.title: 77 Rosehill - Drainage deteriorating pavement. Subsurface drainage pipe damaged, 15th November
item.description:
Property has a sub-pavement drainage gully that takes rainwater from my property, below the pavement, and discharges it directly into the road. At some point in the past few years, maintenance workers did some work on the pavement directly above the pipe and must have damaged it or managed to block it as it stopped draining and was backing up and flooding. Camera inspection of the drain confirms it's filled with concrete, so I am unable to clear it myself. I've since had rainwater redirected from the gutter directly onto the pavement, but this has caused the pavement surface to deteriorate quite badly. I'm looking to either get the sub-surface gully repaired, or to have a surface level concrete gully installed - something like the attached photo (which I've seen in front of a few properties further down the street - photo attached)
